author: Pair C, sub-group DIA5-G3
nature: Routing rule of TD 2 Step 3. TD 1 evidence is read by code from ../traces-td1.csv (104 real calls, 21 October 2026). Resource availability in the scenarios is a simulation assumption, not a measurement.

token_envelope.source: Lecture 2, slide 'Four cases, with real prices': short question, 2,000 tokens in, 500 out (Lecture 1, slide 9). TD 1 measured means are lower (560 to 641 in, 135 to 279 out), so the envelope over-estimates the cost.

levels.1: Period and product filters only (F1, F3): no model returned a wrong value on these 10 cells.
levels.2: Age at the time of the order (F2b, F1+F2b): per-order date arithmetic; 3 of the 5 models returned no wrong value on C10 and C18.
levels.3: Completed age on a reference date, alone or combined (F2, F1+F2, F2+F3, F1+F2+F3): only gpt-oss-120b returned no wrong value on these 8 cells.

uses.dashboard: Internal dashboard: an error misleads an internal reading and is corrected at the next refresh. Low cost of error.
uses.customer: Figure shown to a customer: an error leaves the company, the company is bound by what it displays (Lecture 2, Air Canada case). Medium to high cost.
uses.payout: Amount paid out: an error moves money and is hard to reverse. High cost.

checks.none: No check: one call, the value is delivered as returned.
checks.quorum: k-of-n vote of Step 1 (vote_k_sur_n): strict majority, an unavailable member stays in n, one vote per provider and model pair; abstain without majority.
checks.reference: Validated reference query of the family (reference-td1.csv convention), run read-only on data/boutique.sqlite by the local deterministic route script#script (portfolio G5, local, 0 USD). The model value is delivered only if it is equal; otherwise no delivery, failure logged.
checks.review: A person who can read the source validates before delivery.

P1-2of3.source: Pair C panel for level-1 families: three distinct families (dots, openai, qwen), none with a wrong value on F1 or F3 in TD 1.

all-3of5.source: 3-of-5 quorum over the five TD 1 models (Step 1). gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b belong to the same family.

checks.payout: 3-of-5 quorum, panel all-3of5, then reference; mismatch: no payment, human review
